description:
An AI-enhanced desktop app for a tighter, more focused browsing loop. Less chaos. More flow.

Noi brings an interaction-first workflow refresh for a tighter, more focused browsing loop. It offers multi-window management to run parallel workspaces side by side, session isolation to keep contexts clean, separated, and predictable, and local-first data so history, prompts, and settings stay on-device.
Noi includes prompt management for AI chats to organize, reuse, and iterate on workflows, a built-in terminal for fast local commands, scripts, and tooling, the noi CLI command to control Noi from tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, and multiple themes and visual styles to fit different setups and vibes.
Release Notes
- Fix: Addressed several known issues and improved overall stability.
- Feat: Introduced the new noi CLI command, enabling you to control Noi via command-line tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. More commands will be added over time to expand automation and control capabilities.
